narrative: On the bookwheel. A narrow day-book lies open on the counter at the White Greyhound. Harrison's finger is on a fresh line. The churchyard beyond the stall-board is bright and thin of black gowns. On the bookwheel. The same line, closer. The ink is darker than the lines above it. There is no seal and no second hand. It is a bookseller's note of what he was told.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Read the note and left it on the counter.

entities.name: John Harrison
entities.context: Held the day-book open at the fresh line.
